profile.summary: AI and Machine Learning engineer building production-ready GenAI applications with RAG, FastAPI, LangChain, cloud backends, and practical product workflows.

highlights: Engineered a full-stack AI-driven CA exam preparation platform using Next.js, FastAPI, AWS, Gemini LLMs, and Qdrant.
Delivered automated answer sheet grading and semantic study material retrieval workflows.
Built a voice-based conversational AI system using ElevenLabs and Twilio for real-time interaction.
Developed FastAPI backend services with JWT authentication and DynamoDB for scalable data handling.

projects.title: Personal CFO: AI Financial Guardian
projects.summary: An aggressive, highly analytical, and brutally sarcastic financial guardian designed to protect runway. Powered by Gemini 2.5 Flash, Cloud Firestore, and FastAPI, wired directly to an iPhone Action Button (via Apple Shortcuts) to evaluate spending habits in real time.
projects.impact: Delivers character-building financial roasts, tracks INR runway balances with real-time Firestore persistence, and runs continuous state sync across devices.

projects.title: Technova Society Website
projects.summary: Built and deployed a Next.js and Supabase platform centralizing technical society event management with a gamified dashboard and real-time QR-based attendance.
projects.impact: Scaled impact to 800+ students and supported 5,000+ QR scans for a 24-hour event.

projects.title: Gmail Newsletters to Podcast
projects.summary: Built an automated pipeline that converts newsletters into audio summaries using Gmail API, Gemini 2.5 Flash, ElevenLabs, and Pydub.
projects.impact: Reduced manual reading time by approximately 1 hour daily.

projects.title: AI CA Exam Preparation Platform
projects.summary: A full-stack AI product for automated answer grading and semantic material retrieval using Gemini LLMs, Qdrant, FastAPI, AWS, and Next.js.
projects.impact: Combines RAG, cloud APIs, authentication, and production data handling.
